title: 365daysofweb3
tagline: An NFT based Calendar app with a collection of unique NFTs - each one signifying one day of the year.
description:
The project is a collection of unique NFTs, each of which signifies 1 day of the year. The NFT Metadata can be updated by the owner of the NFT to replace the blank space with text, image, gifs, or a video.
This is a multichain project built on both Harmony and Polygon.
There are two use cases for the calendar:
- An organization or individual can buy a particular NFT date for branding purposes.
- An individual can buy the date for gifting/owning purposes.

Every time, the metadata of a date is updated, it is visible on the calendar platform unless specifically requested to lock by the owner(A surprise NFT that reveals itself on the particular date).
